scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach --all --parallel --exclude valculator run lint
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach --all --parallel --exclude valculator run build
scripts.clean:dist: node -e "const { rmSync, readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const dir of readdirSync('packages')) rmSync('packages/' + dir + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.release: node scripts/check-npm-version.mjs && yarn workspace @valculator/interface build && yarn workspace @valculator/interface npm publish
scripts.deploy:images: yarn workspace cdk exec cdk deploy --require-approval never
